analysis.title: Cinematic Alpine Quality Dashboard
analysis.notes: A dusk mountain landscape creates an immersive, premium backdrop while a large white analytics panel is layered over the right side. Refined serif headlines, muted navy tones, and a vivid lime accent balance institutional credibility with contemporary SaaS energy.
analysis.heroPrompt: Create a cinematic wide alpine mountain landscape at dusk, viewed from an elevated ridge with layered peaks receding into mist. Use deep navy shadows, slate-blue atmospheric distance, muted rust and amber terrain, and a narrow warm horizon beneath a darkening sky. Add a single vivid lime contour line flowing organically across the foreground ridge, suggesting data movement without any text or symbols. Photorealistic terrain, subtle grain, dramatic low light, premium technology-brand art direction, ample dark negative space in the upper left, and composition suitable as a website hero background.
